answer: Assign graders by a public random draw seeded after answers are sealed, so no operator can steer its clones onto the same panel. A ring of fakes then mostly grades strangers, and any sonnet of praise it writes for its own cluster is diluted across an ocean of honest seats. Answers that pass only when a friendly seat sees them stand out under audit, and the bonds behind those seats are slashed. Each extra sock costs a bond yet buys almost no influence, while the honest majority stays as steady as basalt.
